description: Common needs mapped to core features, facades or extension points, and examples for offline MCP find_core_feature (S2.50).

features.summary: Store and attach files through core documents; register documentable on addon record types.
features.example: await ctx.core.documents.create(principal, { ownerType: 'acme-widget.item', ownerId: itemId, filename, bytes });
features.doNot: Do not add a private upload or object-storage client.

features.summary: Send work through the core approvals engine; register the record type as approvable.
features.example: await ctx.core.approvals.guard(principal, { recordType: 'acme-widget.item', recordId: itemId, action: 'publish' });
features.doNot: Do not create an addon-owned approval or status-history table.

features.summary: Register notification types and send through core notify so users control preferences.
features.example:
ctx.notify.registerType({ key: 'acme-widget.due', title: 'Item due' });
await ctx.notify.send(principal, { type: 'acme-widget.due', userId, payload: { itemId } });
features.doNot: Do not keep a private notification table or mail-out side channel.

features.summary: Submit assessments and factors through core risk; contribute factors via the extension point.
features.example: await ctx.risk.submitAssessments(principal, { subjectType: 'party', subjectId: partyId, assessments: [...] });
features.doNot: Do not invent a parallel risk scoring engine in the addon.

features.summary: Declare actions in audit.actions and record with a host principal; map record types to audit subjects.
features.doNot: Do not write a private audit table.

features.summary: Ensure and evaluate flags through core; register flaggable record types when the process needs them.
features.example: await ctx.flags.ensure(principal, { code: 'sanctions_hit', subjectType: 'party', subjectId: partyId });
features.doNot: Do not store flags in an addon-owned table.

features.summary: Register handlers and schedule or enqueue through core jobs; declare job types in the manifest.
features.doNot: Do not add a private scheduler or cron library.

features.summary: Invoke models through Settings-owned AI config; register prompt packs for reusable prompts.
features.example: const result = await ctx.llm.invoke(principal, { promptKey: 'acme-widget.summarize', input: { text } });
features.doNot: Do not hardcode a provider SDK or model name when Settings already own them.

features.summary: Create and update cases through the core case engine; process shape belongs in configuration or packs.
features.example: const created = await ctx.core.cases.create(principal, { templateKey: 'acme-underwriting.application', title });
features.doNot: Do not build a private case or workflow engine.

features.summary: Search and link through core entity services; register linkable for addon record types.
features.example: const hits = await ctx.core.entities.search(principal, { query: name, types: ['party'] });
features.doNot: Do not query core tables directly for search.

features.summary: Gate on host principals and declared permissions; use hasPermission for conditional UI or handlers.
features.doNot: Do not create a private user or role table.

features.summary: Register the record type, then send and list through ctx.core.communication. Mail accounts stay in core.
features.example: await ctx.core.communication.send(principal, { ownerType: 'acme-widget.item', ownerId, to, subject, body });
features.doNot: Do not add a private mail client or SMTP library.
features.note: Owner registration is ctx.extend.registerCommunicable. Tier 2 still refuses that call until communicable is a manifest extend id (S2.19). send and list refuse an owner type this addon did not register.

features.summary: Publish and subscribe with namespaced events declared in the manifest and JSON schemas.
features.doNot: Do not emit through a private bus or unscoped core emit.

features.summary: Read host Settings keys; do not hardcode catalogs a client can rename.
features.doNot: Do not ship a parallel settings store in the addon.

features.summary: Use declared egress via ctx.http.fetch so the host proxy and allow-list apply.
features.doNot: Do not open raw sockets or undeclared fetch around the egress proxy.

features.summary: Register triggers and actions the Weave engine can run; declare extends in the manifest.
features.doNot: Do not build a private rules engine for the same triggers.
